shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST DNS resources

options.name: bgp_config_id
options.description: The ID of the BGP configuration to use to configure layer 3 connectivity

options.name: cnode_ids
options.description: To dedicate a specific group of CNodes to the DNS, list the IDs of the CNodes.

options.name: domain_suffix
options.description:
A suffix for domain names. Requests for domain names with this suffix are resolved to the VIPs configured on the
cluster.

options.name: enable_l3
options.description: Enable layer 3 connectivity

options.name: enabled
options.description: Set to true to enable the DNS service

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: invalid_name_response
options.description: Invalid Name Response

options.name: invalid_type_response
options.description: Invalid Type Response

options.name: name
options.description: Name

options.name: net_type
options.description: Net Type

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies a port for the DNS

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Specifies the TTL value for the DNS.

options.name: vip
options.description:
A virtual IP to assign to the DNS service. DNS requests from your external DNS server must be delegated to this
IP.

options.name: vip_gateway
options.description:
If the external DNS server doesn't reside on the same subnet as the DNS VIP, enter the IP of a gateway through
which to connect to the DNS server.

options.name: vip_ipv6
options.description: Assigns an IPv6 to the DNS service.

options.name: vip_ipv6_gateway
options.description: Specifies a gateway IPv6 to external DNS server if on different subnet.

options.name: vip_ipv6_subnet_cidr
options.description: Specifies the subnet, as a CIDR index, on which the DNS resides. [1..128]

options.name: vip_subnet_cidr
options.description: The subnet, in CIDR format, on which the DNS VIP resides.

options.name: vip_vlan
options.description:
If your external DNS server is only exposed to a specific VLAN, you can enter the VLAN here to enable
communication with the DNS server.

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
